The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I changed one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`.

An unmatched contributor is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. That check uses the 180-day threshold, and a blank latest-commit date already counts as active. Configured teams use a separate code path, so they keep all their members.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='Landscape*'` and it passed with no output. I don't know whether that pattern matched any test classes, and I added no test for the new behaviour.
